links.outcome: Change in model predictions when race/ethnicity and gender descriptors were added to text
links.effect: Fine-tuned models were less likely than ChatGPT to change predictions when race/ethnicity and gender descriptors were added, suggesting less algorithmic bias (p < 0.05).
links.quote: Fine-tuned models were less likely than ChatGPT to change their prediction when race/ethnicity and gender descriptors were added to the text, suggesting less algorithmic bias (p < 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Adding LLM-generated synthetic data to training to address class imbalance for sparsely documented SDoH
Fine-tuning smaller open LLMs versus zero/few-shot prompting of commercial LLMs for information extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (fine-tuned Flan-T5 vs ChatGPT) on extracting social determinants of health from EHR notes and assesses algorithmic bias with counterfactual demographic perturbations, but does not test organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
